decisions.reason: Certified HVAC gasketed plate exchangers sit close to the core offer, and in a growing industry with a hiring firm there is enough slack to carry them while results remain unreported.
The website reports a major market share in water cooling systems, so results appear to meet the aspiration and give no reason to search for alternatives.
The marine cooling unit has its own page and complements the successful box cooler line, so the firm's slack and the product's fit with its marine business favour keeping it.
The compact oil cooler line builds on established know-how, and no shortfall has been reported that would trigger problemistic search, so the growing firm can carry it.
Finned tubes are a component technology that supports the air cooler business, has its own page and fits the core offer, so dropping it is unlikely without evidence of underperformance.
Enhanced tubes reflect the firm's R&D strength and efficiency goals, and with slack available and no reported shortfall, management keeps them.
